blue-kit — Incident Response Playbook

Offline DFIR musobaqasi · 2 kun · ATT&CK v19.2 · javoblar = MITRE ID + remediation · AI TAQIQLANGAN
🔑 5 OLTIN QOIDA (har doim yodда tut)
  1. TEGMA: checker akkaunt/IP, SSH/RDP/WinRM, checker portlari — bularni buzsang SLA ham, remediation ham 0.
  2. Har o'zgarishдан oldin: dalil saqla (backup) → keyin o'chir → tekshir → kerak bo'lsa rollback.
  3. Har ID topshirishдан oldin: bk kb validate. Revoked bo'lsa yangi ID. Urinish limiti bor.
  4. Faqat kapitan topshiradi. Ikki kishi bir javobni kiritib urinish sarflamasin.
  5. Ball vaqt bo'yicha o'sadi — birinchi tuzatgan yutadi. Tez triage, aniq narsani DARHOL tuzat.

0 · Musobaqagacha (uyда, bir marta)

  1. Har laptopга blue-kit-dist.zip ochib qo'y (bk.exe + data + responder + cheat sheet).
  2. Admin PowerShell: Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath "<blue-kit papka>" keyin bk.exe kb info ishlashini tekshir (Defender yemasin).
  3. SSH/RDP klient (MobaXterm/Remmina), Notepad++, brauzer tayyor. USB'да zaxira nusxa.
  4. Tarmoq: laptop firewall YOQIQ, o'z laptopingни boshqa jamoалардан himoyala.
  5. AI plugin/Copilotни O'CHIR (tasodifan ishlab ketsa diskvalifikatsiya).

2 · DAY-1 PLAYBOOK — Moliyaviy firibgarlik

Namuna: phishing → HR → razvedka → buxgalter akkaunti → pul o'tkazma (Buhtrap/RTM uslubi)
Qadam 1 — Scope va boshlang'ich nuqta.
  1. Kibana: vaqt oralig'i, hostlar, event.code top values.
  2. Loglarni CSV eksport (Share → CSV). Ustunlar noaniq bo'lsa: bk logs columns day1.csv
  3. bk logs analyze day1.csv --out r.html --json-out day1.json → HTML'ни och.
Qadam 2 — Hujum zanjirini o'qi (HTML hisobot).
  • Timeline + Chains: qaysi hostда boshlangan? (odatda HR/reception)
  • ATT&CK Coverage: qaysi taktika bo'sh? — o'sha yerни maqsadli qidir.
  • Checker/Beacon: davriy IP'larни belgila — tarixiy beacon = C2 (tuzatiladi), jonli davriy = checker (TEGILMAYDI).
? QAROR — buxgalter akkaunti buzilganmi
  • Qidir: 4625 ko'p (brute) → 4624 success; 4624 type 10 (RDP); RAT o'rnatilishi.
  • Ha bo'lsa → o'sha akkaunt paroli almashtiriladi (P4), va uning amallari (to'lov fayllari) tekshiriladi.
Qadam 3 — G'alati buyruqni ATT&CK'ga bog'la. bk kb search "<logdan buyruq>" bk kb ioc "<IP yoki fayl>" bk kb related T1566.001 # keyin nima kelishi mumkin Tez-tez: T1566.001 (phishing) · T1204.002 · T1059.001 · T1105 (certutil/download) · T1003.001 (lsass) · T1110 (brute) · T1021.001 (RDP) · T1219 (AnyDesk) · T1657/T1565.001 (to'lov).
Qadam 4 — Responder: fokusli triage.
  1. Nishonда kollektor (read-only), Python shart emas: powershell -ep bypass -File collect_windows.ps1 -Out snap.json ssh user@t 'bash -s' < collect_linux.sh > snap.json # Linux
  2. Loglар bilan bog'lab triage (baseline bo'lsa qo'sh): bk resp triage snap.json --from-logs day1.json [--baseline base.json] ✔LOG belgili topilmalar = loglar tasdiqlagan, birinchi shularni tuzat.
Qadam 5 — TUZATISH tartibi (SLA'ни buzmasdan) Har biriдан oldin/keyin: bk resp sla sla.yaml # xizmat ishlayaptimi? bk resp fix snap.json --from-logs day1.json --os windows (buyruqларни beradi — o'zing ko'rib ishlat)
  1. RAT (AnyDesk/TeamViewer) → to'xtat + disable
  2. Persistence: schtask, Run key, servis, WMI → backup → o'chir
  3. Buzilgan akkaunt paroli almashtir; hujumchi yaratgan userни disable/delete
  4. To'lov fayli / rekvizit / hosts fayl → asl holatga (backupдан)
  5. checker akkaunt/IP → --protected ro'yxatда, TEGMA
Scoreboard qizarsa → darhol rollback (backupдан tikla).
Qadam 6 — Topshirish va hisobot. bk kb validate T1657 T1565.001 ... # revoked bormi? Kapitan trackerдан topshiradi. Kun oxirида: bk resp triage snap.json --from-logs day1.json --json > triage.json bk report --logs day1.json --resp triage.json --answers a.yaml --lang uz --out day1_report.html

3 · DAY-2 PLAYBOOK — Zavod servisi ishdan chiqqan (ICS/OT)

Diqqat: bu MITRE ATT&CK for ICS bo'lishi mumkin (T0xxx / v19). Enterprise → OT segmentiga pivot.
Qadam 1 — Nima "ishlamayapti"ни aniqla.
  1. Kollektor → snapshot. Keyin: bk resp doctor snap.json <servis_nomi>
  2. Service Doctor sabablarni beradi: disabled / binary yo'q / config buzilgan / cron o'ldiryapti / port band / dependency / paket buzilgan.
? "Servis ishlamayapti" qaror daraxti
BelgiSababTuzatish
start_mode=Disabledo'chirilganenable + start
binary_path yo'q/o'zgarganalmashtirilganbackupдан tikla / to'g'ri yo'l
config yaqinda o'zgargansabotajconfig diff → tikla → reload
cron/task servisni o'ldiradiwatchdogo'sha cron/taskни o'chir
port boshqa pid'даband qilinganbegona jarayonни to'xtat
Qadam 2 — ICS ATT&CK'ga bog'la. bk kb search "modbus write" --domain ics bk kb validate T0881 --domain ics # ICS ID ham v19'да o'zgargan Tez-tez: T0881 (Service Stop) · T0816 (Restart/Shutdown) · T0836/T0855 (Modify param / Unauth cmd) · T0826 (Loss of Availability).
Qadam 3 — Xizmatни XAVFSIZ tikla
  1. Config/binary → backup → tikla → tekshir (nginx -t, sshd -t va h.k.)
  2. Restart emas, iloji bo'lsa reload. Reboot faqat oxirgi chora.
  3. Funksiyани butunlay o'chirma — validatsiya qo'sh (checker uni ishlatadi).
  4. Tiklashдан keyin: bk resp sla sla.yaml # DEGRADED emasmi?
  5. Watchdog qolmaganини tekshir (5–10 daq keyin qayta tekshir).
1-kун → 2-kun bog'liqligi: 1-kunда o'g'irlangan credential/IP/hash 2-kunда boshqa segmentга kirish uchun ishlatilishi mumkin. 1-kун IOC'larини saqla — 2-kun birinchi shularни qidir. Kun oxirида hamma narsани eksport qil (loglar, snapshot, tracker).

Tashkilotchilardan so'ra

  • Sub-technique shartmi (T1059.001 vs T1059)? Urinish limiti nechta, har savolga alohidami?
  • Remediation qanday tekshiriladi? SLA qancha vaqtда bir? Scoreboardда ko'rinadimi?
  • Aktiv skanerlash ruxsatmi? Router/firewall senariy qismimi?
  • 2-kун yangi tizimmi yoki 1-kун holati saqlanadimi?

2 kunlik omon qolish

  • Birinchi 30 daqiqа reja. Bitta narsага 30–40 daqiqадан ko'p ketsa belgilab keyingiga o't.
  • Remediation'ни oxirги soatга qoldirma — topilma tasdiqlanishi bilan parallel tuzat.
  • Uxlash, ovqat, suv. Charchoq xatolari ko'p ball yeydi.
  • Boshqa jamoалар tarmog'ига tegma (diskvalifikatsiya).
